using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.ChatCompletion;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.MistralAI.Client.UnitTests;

public class MistralClientTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async void GetChatMessageContentsAsync_LogsDebugWhenToolCallPresentAndDebugEnabled()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
        mockLogger.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug)).Returns(true);
        var mockHttpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
        var chatHistory = new ChatHistory();
        var mockKernel = new Mock<Kernel>();
        var executionSettings = new MistralAIPromptExecutionSettings
        {
            ToolCallBehavior = new() { MaximumAutoInvokeAttempts = 1 }
        };

        var mistralClient = new MistralClient(
            modelId: "test-model",
            httpClient: mockHttpClient.Object,
            apiKey: "test-key",
            logger: mockLogger.Object);

        // Act
        await mistralClient.GetChatMessageContentsAsync(chatHistory, CancellationToken.None, executionSettings, mockKernel.Object);

        // Assert
        mockLogger.Verify(
            l => l.LogDebug(
                It.IsAny<string>(),
                It.IsAny<object[]>(),
                It.IsAny<Exception>()),
            Times.AtLeastOnce);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async void GetChatMessageContentsAsync_DoesNotLogDebugWhenToolCallAbsent()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
        mockLogger.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug)).Returns(true);
        var mockHttpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
        var chatHistory = new ChatHistory();
        var mockKernel = new Mock<Kernel>();
        var executionSettings = new MistralAIPromptExecutionSettings();

        var mistralClient = new MistralClient(
            modelId: "test-model",
            httpClient: mockHttpClient.Object,
            apiKey: "test-key",
            logger: mockLogger.Object);

        // Act
        await mistralClient.GetChatMessageContentsAsync(chatHistory, CancellationToken.None, executionSettings);

        // Assert - Debug log should not be called since no tool call path is taken
        mockLogger.Verify(
            l => l.LogDebug(
                It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("Tool requests")),
                It.IsAny<object[]>(),
                It.IsAny<Exception>()),
            Times.Never);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async void GetChatMessageContentsAsync_DoesNotLogDebugWhenDebugDisabled()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
        mockLogger.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug)).Returns(false);
        var mockHttpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>();
        var chatHistory = new ChatHistory();
        var mockKernel = new Mock<Kernel>();
        var executionSettings = new MistralAIPromptExecutionSettings
        {
            ToolCallBehavior = new() { MaximumAutoInvokeAttempts = 1 }
        };

        var mistralClient = new MistralClient(
            modelId: "test-model",
            httpClient: mockHttpClient.Object,
            apiKey: "test-key",
            logger: mockLogger.Object);

        // Act
        await mistralClient.GetChatMessageContentsAsync(chatHistory, CancellationToken.None, executionSettings, mockKernel.Object);

        // Assert - Debug check returns false, so LogDebug not called
        mockLogger.Verify(
            l => l.LogDebug(
                It.IsAny<string>(),
                It.IsAny<object[]>(),
                It.IsAny<Exception>()),
            Times.Never);
    }
}
